'''Aeldrine Marinye''' was a dye [[merchant]] from [[Tanchico]].

==History==
When Aeldrine chose to become a merchant, her mother [[Collaris]] disapproved. She did, however, amass a tidy fortune trading dyes. One of the things that she taught her her daughter [[Beonin Marinye|Beonin]] was it is always possible to better oneself. Later, Beonin continued a "family tradition" by going to the [[White Tower]] and becoming [[Aes Sedai]] against Aeldrine's wishes.{{ref/book|11|2}}

==Activities==
While on her way to [[Tar Valon]], Beonin looks over some jewelry passed on to her by her mother and grandmother. These mementos made her think of them.{{ref/book|11|2}}
